from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")

def edit(rel, replacements):
    p=ROOT/rel
    s=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig" if rel.endswith(".xaml") else "utf-8")
    original=s
    for old,new in replacements:
        if old not in s:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{rel}: expected text not found: {old[:120]!r}")
        s=s.replace(old,new,1)
    enc="utf-8-sig" if rel.endswith(".xaml") else "utf-8"
    p.write_text(s,encoding=enc,newline="")
    print("EDITED",rel)
